fact: The IFC report says the World Bank's Findex 2021 puts account ownership among Tunisian adults at 37%, unchanged from 2017.
Challenges TN, citing Global Findex, says 37.8 per cent of Tunisian adults held an account with a financial institution or mobile money service in 2024.
Tunisie Numerique, citing the World Bank, says 37% of Tunisians held a financial account in 2024, 29% of women and 32% of low-income people.
